claims.quote: restored 1930s city incinerator known as The Destructor — decommissioned in the 80s, raves in the 90s, restored 2018; vast industrial taproom, loft vibe, big patio
'the most mainstream of the breweries in the area — good standard beers and playful rotating options like earl grey tea'
claims.note: Comparative places it BELOW its Symes Rd neighbours on beer, ABOVE on room. Old Cawthra Ave Yelp listing reads closed — that is the 2018 MOVE, not a closure.
